summary: E48 identified the w_refs safe window [0.026, 0.030] empirically (score=1.0 inside, 0.96 outside). E57 derives it analytically from goldset pair constraints: (1) lower bound = max(|non_refs_deficit|/refs_delta) over pairs where A>B but A is longer with more refs = 0.025000 (eee30>1f936: need w_refs>0.025 to overcome -0.05 len disadvantage with 2-ref advantage); (2) upper bound = min(non_refs_margin/refs_delta) over pairs where A>B but B has more refs = 0.030833 (332>cecf: 0.0925 len+noise margin / 3-ref delta). Window width = 0.005833. Proposed w_refs=0.028 sits at 0.003 from each cliff — effectively the window midpoint (analytic center = 0.027917). E48's empirical choice was within 0.0002 of optimal. This analytic derivation enables pre-screening any future w_refs proposal without running the full evaluator, and pre-screening any new goldset case to determine whether it narrows the safe window before admission.
evidence: Lower bound: eee30 (len=224,refs_cap=4) > 1f936 (len=124,refs_cap=2) — same type. non_refs=-0.050 (len penalty). Need w_refs>0.050/2=0.025000
Upper bound: 332 (len=224,refs_cap=2) > cecf (len=409,refs_cap=5) — same type. non_refs=+0.0925 (len+noise margin). Cliff at w_refs=0.0925/3=0.030833
Empirical probe confirms: w_refs=0.025 -> OrderScore=0.8 (below lower), w_refs=0.030 -> score=1.0 (inside), w_refs=0.031 -> OrderScore=0.8 (above upper)
w_refs=0.028: dist_to_lower=0.003, dist_to_upper=0.00283 — balanced near midpoint 0.02792
Next upper constraint (1f936>e8d18 pair): 0.08225 — not binding. Only 332>cecf determines upper cliff.
E48 empirical window [0.026, 0.030] matches analytic window (0.025, 0.03083) rounded to safe integer steps
mechanism: For any ordered pair (A>B) in goldset where B.refs_cap > A.refs_cap (B has more refs but should rank lower): the margin M = (type_delta + len_delta + noise_delta) - (B.refs_cap - A.refs_cap)*w_refs must stay positive. This gives w_refs < M/(refs_delta). The minimum such bound over all at-risk pairs is the binding upper cliff. Symmetrically, pairs where A.refs_cap > B.refs_cap and non_refs margin is negative require w_refs > |non_refs|/refs_delta (lower cliff). The safe window is (max_lower, min_upper) = (0.025000, 0.030833). The evaluator script (scratch/autoresearch_init_evaluator_v1.py) computes rank_score with min(n_refs,5) cap — this cap is load-bearing: without it, cecf (n_refs=6) would contribute 6*w_refs instead of 5*w_refs, tightening the upper cliff to 0.0925/4=0.023125, which would make w_refs=0.028 unsafe.
hypothesis: If analytic_cliff_bounds() is added to the evaluator, any future goldset expansion or w_refs proposal can be pre-screened without full empirical re-probing. New cases with refs-heavy risk packets shorter than cecf could tighten the upper bound below 0.030833.
